_comment: Euronext house style tokens - the ONLY permitted theme (templates/registry.json id 'enx-theme'). Every renderer under functions/delivery/renderers-src/ and every HTML template under templates/assets/ reads its palette, typography and classification strings from this file, and the verifier's house-style rule checks delivered artefacts against it. Changing a value here is a TEMPLATE CHANGE: owner approval, scripts/update_templates.py, audit line, new agent version (operations/CHANGE_MANAGEMENT.md, finding C19). Ad-hoc themes (theme-factory, brand-guidelines) are NOT deployed - see templates/themes/euronext-house.md.

risk_glyphs._comment: HTML entities only - never literal Unicode (PHASE 4B rule 3 of the DeepSearch protocol).

charts._cdn_note: Only cdnjs.cloudflare.com is permitted; renderers must not fetch any other host. No Euronext data is ever sent to the CDN - the script is fetched, nothing is posted (governance/DATA_PROTECTION_GUARDRAILS.md section 1).

classification._sensitivity_label_note: The Purview sensitivity label applied to the stored file is NOT set here: it comes from templates/registry.json 'sensitivity_label' per template (or the library default) and is applied by the delivery Function /assign_label route (finding C16).
